identitySignals: Agenda abbreviation 'OPEF' matches the abbreviation the Oakland Public Education Fund uses for itself on oaklandedfund.org documents

Located in Oakland, CA and describes itself as the nonprofit partner of Oakland Unified School District; Life Academy (the school in the agenda item) directs donations to the Oakland Public Education Fund

Name mismatch: agenda says 'Foundation', registered legal name is 'The Oakland Public Education Fund'. No separate organization named 'Oakland Public Education Foundation' was found, but the district's wording is not an exact match
research.notes: Agenda item (2025-02-26, L.-99, Life Academy Measures N and H budget modification) names 'Oakland Public Education Foundation (OPEF)'. The registered organization is 'The Oakland Public Education Fund' (OPEF). Likely a district naming error, but not confirmed, so left at medium. A separate vendor key n-oakland-public-education-fund exists and probably refers to the same organization; a reviewer may want to merge them.

profile.summary: A nonprofit that raises and manages community resources for Oakland public schools. It places volunteers in classrooms, runs educator grant programs, and acts as a fiscal sponsor for education projects. It partners with Oakland Unified School District.
